blind.description: An oval wooden banquet/dining table featuring a polished reddish-brown tabletop with a lighter orange/gold inlaid border stripe and decorative dots along one straight edge. The tabletop is supported by two pedestal bases, each terminating in four curved splayed legs with gold/brass capped feet. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: An elongated pill/capsule-shaped oval tabletop with a warm reddish-brown wood surface, outlined by an inner orange band border with a row of small dots along one elongated edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (reaching roughly lower-mid torso/hip level of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 5.5 to 6 feet long.
